subject.title: [Feature]: Batch WhatsApp messages by messageTimestamp instead of receive time

question: Should WhatsApp text timestamp coalescing be added, and if so should it be opt-in or default-on, what timestamp tolerance should it use, and how should it interact with existing `debounceMs` scopes?
rationale: The source-level gap is clear, but `messageTimestamp` is second-resolution and the proposed fix creates public config/default semantics, so automation should not choose over-batching risk or upgrade behavior for maintainers.

options.title: Add opt-in WhatsApp timestamp coalescing
options.body: Introduce a WhatsApp-owned config mode with conservative same account/conversation/sender scoping and focused tests while leaving existing receive-time debounce behavior unchanged by default.

options.title: Make narrow timestamp coalescing default-on
options.body: Batch exact same-timestamp same-sender WhatsApp text by default for better forward-plus-comment UX, accepting a higher compatibility and over-batching risk.

options.title: Do not add timestamp coalescing
options.body: Keep the current receive-time debounce model and handle batching needs through existing or separate config requests such as per-group debounce.

recommendation.title: Add opt-in WhatsApp timestamp coalescing
recommendation.body: Introduce a WhatsApp-owned config mode with conservative same account/conversation/sender scoping and focused tests while leaving existing receive-time debounce behavior unchanged by default.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete posted the prior maintainer review and has the strongest combined signal across shared debounce, config, docs, and the product/config decision surface.
